subject: Proposal: Accelerated commit & tier expansion — Acme Retail
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Watson <emma@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Accelerated commit & tier expansion — Acme Retail

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Acme's usage has spiked ahead of the spring promotion and your team is close to the current hosted commit ceiling. To avoid throttling and preserve latency SLOs, we've put together a short proposal to move you from the current 1.2M token/month commit to a stepped 3.5M token/month commitment with an optional burst pocket.

High-level proposal (month 1 -> month 12):
- Base commit: 3,500,000 tokens / month
- Burst allowance: +20% monthly (billed at burst rate)
- Average per-token rate: $0.00035 (volume-discounted, blended)
- SLA: 99.9% regional uptime for hosted API endpoints (US), with failover to secondary pool
- Onboard window: 10 business days for rate-lane activation and traffic shaping rules

Value-adds included in this tier: priority slot for autoscale bursts, token-level telemetry retention (90 days), and 2 dedicated incident reviews in the first 90 days.

I attached a short scope doc and the updated rate card (see attachments). Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm you want the stepped commit and burst allowance
2) I’ll issue an updated SOW + DocuSign link for signature
3) Karthik and our finance team will coordinate invoicing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly)

If procurement needs a one-line summary for approval, feel free to reuse the sentence: "Redwood Inference: 3.5M token/month hosted commitment, $0.00035/token blended, 20% burst pocket, 99.9% SLA (US)."

Are you available Thursday to finalize timing?

Best,

--
Kimberly Park
Account Lead, West Coast
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: proposed-SOW-acme-03-2028.pdf (PDF), rate-card-v2.xlsx (Excel)

From: Emma Watson <emma@acme-retail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Retail Procurement <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Accelerated commit & tier expansion — Acme Retail

Hi Kimberly,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear summary. This looks like the right path — traffic projections show we will need at least the 3.5M commitment for the next quarter. Procurement has two follow-ups before legal signs off:

- Can you provide a 12-month and a 24-month pricing comparison (total committed spend and effective blended rate)?
- What is the process for short-term top-ups if we exceed the burst allowance in a month? Do we get immediate capacity or is there a cooldown?

Also please copy someone from engineering so we can coordinate the rollout window. I can do Thursday afternoon PT.

Thanks,

Emma Watson
Senior Product Manager, Personalization
Acme Retail
emma@acme-retail.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Watson <emma@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Mar 2028 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Accelerated commit & tier expansion — Acme Retail

Thanks Emma — quick answers inline and attaching the 12/24 month comparison workbook for procurement: rate-card-v2.xlsx.

- 12 vs 24 month pricing: see sheet "term-compare" in the attachment. TL;DR: 24-month lock gives an additional 8% discount off the blended rate and lowers burst billing by ~10%.
- Short-term top-ups: we offer immediate temporary capacity via our burst pool up to +50% for emergency windows (subject to available capacity). Above that, we can enable a time-bound temporary uplift that is effective within 30 minutes once finance approves a short-term invoice. We’ll include a one-click top-up flow for your SRE team in the console.

To answer your coordination ask: Ben (CS) will own the rollout checklist and Neha (solutions) will own the onboarding playbook. Karthik — finance cadence (monthly invoice vs quarterly) — can you confirm recommended invoicing cadence for Acme?

I’ll bring a DocuSign exec SOW link to Thursday’s call and we can finalize the activation window.

Meeting slot: Thursday 16:00 PT works for me. Please send calendar invite to all.

Best,

--
Kimberly Park
Account Lead, West Coast
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rate-card-v2.xlsx (Excel)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Mar 2028 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Accelerated commit & tier expansion — Acme Retail

Kimberly / team —

Recommend monthly invoicing with a 30-day net payment term for this customer. Given the size of the uplift, we should set up a consumption escrow and an overage pre-approval threshold of 25% before additional invoices go for PO approval. I’ll prepare a one-page payment cadence appendix to attach to the SOW.

Also tagging finance ops to provision the billing codes so we can enable one-click top-ups without manual approval under the 25% threshold.

Karthik
Director, Financial Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Emma Watson <emma@acme-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Mar 2028 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Accelerated commit & tier expansion — Acme Retail

On Wed, Mar 6, 2028 at 10:45 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> To answer your coordination ask: Ben (CS) will own the rollout checklist and Neha (solutions) will own the onboarding playbook. Karthik — finance cadence (monthly invoice vs quarterly) — can you confirm recommended invoicing cadence for Acme?

Thanks — confirmed. I’ll draft the rollout checklist and attach the runbook for the SRE handoff in the meeting. Key activities:
- Validate model variant pinning and KV cache warm-up (pre-rollout)
- Configure autoscale thresholds and soft-throttle guardrails
- Run smoke tests with 25% traffic and validate latency under load
- Production cutover and 48 hour monitoring window with daily check-ins

I’ll post the checklist to the shared Drive and link it in the DocuSign SOW so Acme has everything in one place.

Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments (to be added after call): rollout-checklist.md, sres-handbook.pdf
